detailed_descriptions.en: A chaotic simulation with fast-paced rounds, ridiculous financial problems, and just enough bad decisions to make everything worse. Welcome to a tiny utility room next to a recycling factory. Your rent keeps going up, the clock keeps ticking, and your boss has absolutely no sympathy for your financial situation. Scratch lottery tickets, sort junk, earn money, and upgrade your little operation. Every decision matters when you're trying to stay one step ahead of the next deadline. When the work is done, there's always somewhere to blow off steam. Explore the club, make questionable choices, earn Prestige, and come back stronger. Work hard. Scratch harder.
